label: early original input (t=2-3) of 0/b/d/m/s/h following s/d/i/h/b/m/0/y
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase, at early positions: t=2 holds 55% of activation mass and t=3 holds 30%. It never fires at t=0 and almost never at t>=5 or on the delimiter. Which tokens it fires on matters a lot. The input token is usually 0 (44% of mass), b (19%) or d (17%), less often m, s, h, i or l. It fires more when the previous token is one of s, d, i, h, b, m, 0 or y, so it looks like a pairwise code over the current and previous tokens. Restricted to inputs 0/b/d at t=2-3 after those previous tokens, precision is about 0.88. Activations are strongest on input 0 at t=2-3 (e.g. d 0 or s s 0). The copy phase holds only about 5% of mass, weakly at recall_idx 2, 5 and 6. Misses include the same tokens after other previous tokens, and some l/h activations in the copy phase. False positives are matching token pairs that stay silent, so the code is not fully captured by the current and previous token.
